sitat: Secondary results which accounted for the timing of partial sick leave suggest that partial sick leave had no effect on the duration of sick leave.

The unadjusted effect of partial sick leave on sick leave duration was 1.40, which indicates that employees with partial sick leave had 1.40 times longer sick leave than the employees with fulltime sick leave
